Five accepted profiles opened live; all five deduplicated by required npm command plus manual identity checks. Evidence gaps retained in rejected rather than candidates. No LinkedIn fetched, login, CAPTCHA/bot-check bypass, GitHub Issues/PRs, roster edits, ID assignment, downloads or state-changing git commands. Portrait URLs are source leads for downstream vetting, not installed assets. Only this output JSON was written. Tests/build not run because they can stamp public/updates.json and the brief prohibits other writes; JSON structure is validated directly.
